stem: A 4-year-old child is being assessed for autism spectrum disorder, and a junior doctor asks about the role of the Autism Diagnostic Observation Schedule (ADOS); which statement is most accurate?

options.text: ADOS is mandatory for every diagnosis of autism spectrum disorder
ADOS replaces the need for developmental assessment
ADOS is used in addition to developmental assessment and is not always necessary for diagnosis of autism spectrum disorder
ADOS is the preferred intellectual assessment for children aged 4 years and over
ADOS is mainly used to distinguish expressive from receptive language in toddlers

explanation: ADOS is used in addition to developmental assessment and is not always necessary for diagnosis of autism spectrum disorder. It can support the assessment, but it does not replace a broader developmental evaluation.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf p.16

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because ADOS is not required in every case and is not mandatory for all diagnoses of autism spectrum disorder
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because ADOS does not replace developmental assessment; it is used alongside it
optionExplanations.C: Correct because ADOS is an autism-specific tool that can add useful information to the assessment, but diagnosis does not always depend on it
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because intellectual assessment is a separate process and ADOS is not the preferred test for cognitive ability
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because distinguishing expressive from receptive language is not the main role of ADOS

sourceRefs: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
